    Class TpIconButton

    The custom <tp-icon-button> element provides an icon action button with an accessible text label.

    Example

    <tp-box data-intro-action="counter" data-allow-script="">
      <p>Activate the heart button to add a like.</p>
      <tp-icon-button name="heart" label="Like this example" data-demo-trigger=""></tp-icon-button>
      <p data-demo-status="" role="status">Likes: 0</p>
      <script src="/docs/components/_shared/introduction-actions.js"></script>
    </tp-box>

    Tagname

    tp-icon-button

    Attr

    outlined = false - Uses an outlined appearance instead of a filled background.

    Attr

    pill = false - Rounds the button ends to form a pill.

    Attr

    loading = false - Displays a loading spinner and prevents activation while present.

    Attr

    loading-mode = replace - Spinner layout while loading: replace hides the label; inline keeps the label beside the spinner.

    Attr

    href = "" - Destination URL. A nonempty value renders a link instead of a native button.

    Attr

    target = "" - Browsing context for href, such as _self, _blank or a named frame; ignored in native button mode.

    Attr

    rel = "" - Space-separated relationship tokens forwarded to the link, for example noopener noreferrer; applies only with href.

    Attr

    download = "" - Suggested download filename when href is set. A nonempty value requests a download; browser and server rules determine whether it is honored.

    Attr

    name = "" - Identifier of the icon displayed inside the button, resolved in library.

    Attr

    src = "" - Image or SVG URL forwarded to the icon; takes precedence over name.

    Attr

    library = "" - Icon registry used to resolve name, for example tp, components, languages or a custom registered library.

    Attr

    label = "" - Accessible button name and hover title. Provide the action, such as Close or Search, because the control has no visible text label.

    Attr

    type = "button" - Native button action: button, submit or reset; ignored when href is set.

    Attr

    variant = "neutral" - Color variant: neutral, brand, success, danger, warning or info.

    Attr

    size = "m" - Button and icon size preset: xxs, xs, s, m, l, xl or xxl.

    Attr

    color = "" - Color forwarded to the internal <tp-icon>.

    Attr

    scale = 1 - Scale forwarded to the internal <tp-icon>.

    Attr

    rotate = "0deg" - Rotation forwarded to the internal <tp-icon>.

    Attr

    flip-h = false - Horizontal flip forwarded to the internal <tp-icon>.

    Attr

    flip-v = false - Vertical flip forwarded to the internal <tp-icon>.

    Attr

    spin = false - Continuous spin forwarded to the internal <tp-icon>.

    Attr

    disabled = false - Prevents activation, including link navigation, and marks the control as disabled.

    Accessibility

    Uses a native button or link and hides the decorative icon from the accessible name.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Set label to a concise name that describes the action.

    Keyboard

    Uses native button activation; links activate with Enter.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-icon-button-focus-ring=currentColor] Color of the outline shown when the button receives keyboard focus.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-icon-button-hover-background=color-mix( in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent )] Background color of the button on hover.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-icon-button-icon-size=1em] Width and height of the icon inside the button; distinct from the clickable area.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-icon-button-radius=999rem] Corner radius of the clickable button.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-icon-button-size=1.75em] Minimum width and height of the clickable button; size presets also update this value. click Native click event bubbling from the inner button when activated by pointer or keyboard; disabled controls suppress activation. This is not a CustomEvent, so there is no custom detail payload.

    Eventdetail

    click void
